question: In the fluidized-bed sewage sludge co-incineration, how often were feed packages added to the bed, and what did each package weigh?
expect: one package every 20 s; 2.45 g per package (sec. 2.1, 2.2)
rendered:
According to the document, the feed packages were added to the bed at a rate of one package every 20 seconds. 

Each package weighed a total of 2.45 g, which consisted of a dried sludge matrix mixed with wood chips and polypropylene (PP) pellets, packaged in polyethylene (PE) bags.
